description: Soul Architect lifecycle hooks. Every hook makes the soul feel ALIVE.

hooks.name: State of the Soul
hooks.description: Injects a 'state of the soul' summary at the beginning of every Claude Code session. Reads the soul's current state, PLT scores, recent memories, and focus.

hooks.name: Soul Guardian
hooks.description: Validates every tool use against the soul's values. Can block dangerous operations, warn on high-tax actions, and enforce the sacred covenant.

hooks.name: Soul Memory Scribe
hooks.description: Logs every significant action to the soul's memory, updates PLT scores, and appends to the decision journal. Makes the soul remember.
